summary: Iteration 6 (5-feature batch) backend testing. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_features.py (11 tests). 7 pass, 4 fail surfacing CRITICAL backend implementation gaps. Prior 114-test suite (test_andromeda_api/test_p2_features/test_owner_portal/test_p3c_p3d/test_kds/test_iteration5_smoke) still passes 114/114 — no regression. Frontend preview at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was sleeping (bot detection wall) during the run so live UI walk-through could not be completed, but static code review of OrderScreen/DriverScreen/TableLayoutEditor/LoginScreen/client.js confirms the data-testids, source pills, claim/setPayment wiring are all present — they just fail at runtime because the backend endpoints they call do not exist.

critical.issue: Endpoint NOT IMPLEMENTED — returns 404 'Not Found'. routes/orders.py has no @router.post('/orders/{order_id}/claim'). DriverScreen.jsx calls ordersApi.claim() which 404s; driver flow is completely broken end-to-end.
Endpoint NOT IMPLEMENTED — returns 404. routes/orders.py is missing the /payment route. DriverScreen 'Collected cash' button calls ordersApi.setPayment() which 404s.

`source` field NOT persisted. routes/orders.py create_order() builds the order doc without copying payload.source — every order is saved with the default 'in-store' regardless of what the client sent. Spec requires Swiggy/Zomato/Phone/Other to round-trip.

Recipe-driven inventory decrement NOT IMPLEMENTED. No _apply_recipes() call in routes/orders.py — even after recipe is saved via PUT /menu/items/{id}/recipes (which works), placing an order does not decrement db.inventory.stock. Test verified: inventory.stock stays at 94 before/after a qty=2 order against a wired recipe.

Overlap guard BROKEN for same-timestamp bookings. routes/reservations.py overlap query is `{'at': {'$lt': payload.at, '$gte': ''}}` which only matches reservations whose `at` is strictly LESS than the new one — when two bookings share the exact same `at`, the second one is accepted with 200 (no 409). Should query the time-window pair, not lt+gte ''.

Layout-editor fields stripped from API response. routes/_shared.table_doc_to_response() returns only {id,number,seats,status,orderId} — it drops x, y, width, height, shape, rotation. So even though PATCH .../position writes them to Mongo, the frontend TableLayoutEditor cannot read them back via GET /api/tables. The Table response_model declares those fields with defaults ('square', 0), masking the omission.

integration_issues.issue: Buttons in DriverScreen.jsx call ordersApi.claim/setPayment which hit 404 endpoints — driver workflow non-functional. Toast will show 'Could not claim' / 404 detail.
Selecting Swiggy/Zomato/Phone has no effect on persisted order — backend silently ignores `source`, every order is stored as in-store. OrderScreen pill UI itself renders correctly per code review.
After Save, reopening editor will see all tables back at default positions because GET /api/tables doesn't return x/y/shape/rotation.

issues: Preview environment returned 'Preview Unavailable' bot-detect screen on this run — live UI tests could not be executed. Backend tests proxy successfully through REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api.

action_items: Add POST /api/orders/{order_id}/claim in routes/orders.py: require role 'Driver' (403 for others), find order with status='ready' and driver=None, set driver=user.id; 404 if already claimed or wrong status.
Add PATCH /api/orders/{order_id}/payment in routes/orders.py taking {payment: OrderPayment}; FastAPI will return 422 for invalid literal values automatically via Pydantic.
In routes/orders.py create_order(), add `"source": payload.source` to the doc dict (current code copies type/status/customer/... but skips source).

Implement _apply_recipes() in routes/orders.py: for each ordered item, look up recipes matching menu_item_id (+ size if provided), then db.inventory.update_one({id: inventory_id}, {"$inc": {"stock": -qty * recipe.qty}}). Call from create_order BEFORE inserting the order (or after; must be tenant-scoped).

Fix reservation overlap guard in routes/reservations.py: replace the misleading lt+gte''  query with a proper window-intersection check (e.g., fetch all booked/seated reservations for the table within a wide bracket, then compare time windows in Python — the post-fetch timedelta check already exists, just gate it correctly). Same-`at` duplicates must yield 409.
Extend table_doc_to_response in routes/_shared.py to include x/y/width/height/shape/rotation so the layout editor can restore positions after save.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/orders.py is missing TWO advertised endpoints (/claim, /payment) and one model field write (source) — the iteration's developer-facing client.js (ordersApi.claim/setPayment) is wired but the server side was never delivered.

Reservation overlap query in routes/reservations.py:44–51 is structurally wrong: `{'at': {'$lt': payload.at, '$gte': ''}}` will never match a same-time booking; also `$gte: ''` is a no-op (string compare against ISO timestamps happens to work but is fragile). Switch to a proper window-intersection: fetch reservations for the table with `at` between (payload.at − 3h, payload.at + 3h), then compare windows in Python.

routes/_shared.table_doc_to_response strips layout fields. Either return the full doc (it already excludes _id via PROJECTION) or extend the mapping. Currently the Table pydantic response_model fills in defaults, hiding the bug.

Recipe path is half-built: the GET/PUT /menu/items/{id}/recipes works, but POST /orders does not consume the recipes (no _apply_recipes step in routes/orders.py:26). This was explicitly called out in the iteration scope.
Frontend client.js already imports reservationsApi (used where?) — confirm the Tables UI surfaces the booking flow; iteration brief mentioned API only, no UI, which matches.

Driver flow front-end gracefully toasts the backend error, so users will see 'Not Found' instead of crashing — acceptable failure mode, but the feature is dead until backend ships /claim and /payment.
